expectations.text: Checks that the Id in config.json matches the [Guid] on the record
Notes that ids are GUIDs, not name strings like pingu.camera
Checks the assembly opts into [assembly: AuthoredRegistry] so a reader is generated
Mentions PAUT005 or a missing/malformed [Guid] as a compile-time cause
Explains the registry lookup is what produces the 'not a component this build knows' message
